reborn-1139.rationale: The old English TCG text says to select a face-up Spell that remains on the field but omits the controller restriction. Official Japanese Neuron text/Q&A explicitly restricts the activation target to one face-up Spell the activating player controls, and current official Spanish/German TCG texts likewise say 'you control'. The Japanese Q&A also confirms that the destruction replacement does not start a Chain and applies by removing the placed counter when that Spell would be destroyed by a card effect. The exact pinned Lua targets only a face-up Spell in the activating player's Spell & Trap Zone, places the counter, and registers a non-chain destruction replacement that removes one counter while excluding rule/replacement destruction. The executable behavior therefore matches the authoritative current cross-language rule despite the stale English wording.

note: Script-hash-bound review resolving Magic Reflector's stale English controller wording using official Neuron cross-language text and Q&A.
